soundness_flags.label: Theorem: high-smoothness density robustness
soundness_flags.one_line: Its root-n lower-bound conclusion invokes the preceding oracle theorem's nondegenerate constant-contrast submodel condition, but this condition is neither included in the theorem nor made a model-class assumption.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The preprint introduces a conditional distributional treatment-effect estimand, a locally asymptotically minimax doubly robust estimator, and a global-homogeneity test with valid type-I error and fixed-alternative consistency.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Theorem 1 and Section 4 as identified by the journal record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article derives a Hölder-model CATE minimax rate, uses localized fuzzy hypotheses for its lower bound, and analyzes a local-polynomial higher-order R-learner under attainability conditions.
The empirical-HOIF paper removes a density-smoothness requirement for efficient estimation of a scalar MAR mean and extends the construction to scalar doubly robust functionals.

source_verification_receipts.version: preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 52(3), 2024, pp. 1076--1101
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The direct two-sample work proves MMD nonoptimality under its source-class separation metric, gives minimax spectral regularization, and obtains adaptive aggregation up to a logarithmic penalty.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add an explicit nondegenerate local submodel condition to the high-smoothness theorem (or prove it follows from the declared model class), then state the root-n lower reduction under that condition rather than importing it implicitly.

Evaluate the occupancy--Gram functional under the bounded density band and state a corollary showing exactly whether it differs from the uniform-design exponent or only its constants; this makes the proposed obstruction falsifiable before the full proof.

For the flagship frontier, specify a legal covariance-profile kernel/submodel family for which every fuzzy alternative has the required eigen-decay and source membership, rather than leaving feasibility only as a downstream obligation.

recommended_next_step: Revise the high-smoothness theorem to state its needed nondegeneracy premise, then advance the field-tier arbitrary-density frontier to Stage 0.
